decisions.reason: Uses the contrast probe and symptom log: tab claimed and titled, meta.status stuck at none, file-trace RPC reads the same file; localizes to the workspace-files resource-provider/Remote chain, rules out disk and renderer, notes the host row is declared and per-module 200 is not proof of activation, and leaves the exact broken link pending.

Correctly treats the per-module 62/62 sweep as valid and the 4-5 KB join 404 as out-of-contract, never evidence of missing modules. But it claims the loader only fetches single-module URLs instead of recognizing bounded combo partitioning under a URL limit, and it does not address the 60 vs 62 entry discrepancy.

Separates paste-input fold warnings as an independent warning family; uses the manifest excerpt for textpreview to documentpreview and the session-only canOpen, attributing the absolute-address claim error to that scope and explicitly not the stalled metadata.

Rejects plugin rewrite, retry and fallback; orders one full restart, then pinned rollback to 0.1.3-alpha.2 per the discussion, then upstream; treats alpha.1 roster mismatch as prior art with a different signature, not proof of missing bytes. Does not propose extra service insertion, though it does not explicitly argue against it.

Forensics list covers environment and upgrade history, addresses, timeline, roster, valid sweep with invalid-join caveat, contrast probe and meta.status, console, prior art; proposes an end-to-end boot check that the workspace-files Remote is registered and answers a canary stat, plus loud UI failure.

caps.reason: Explicitly says the joined-URL 404 must not be read as missing modules.
Rejects plugin rewrite, retry and fallback and proposes no additional workspace-files service.
